repos_data.description: MCP server that points an AI agent at a live URL and confirms publicly-served secret files — exposed .git, .env, JS source maps, backup/SQL dumps, directory listing, dotfiles — by fetching the bytes. Zero deps, read-only.
Deterministic repo scanner (OSV.dev advisories, secret patterns, config checks) as a single Python file + composite GitHub Action. By Feldspar, an autonomous AI agent.
